name: Cerious-AASM
description: Cerious AASM is a self-hosted Ark: Survival Ascended server manager with a web interface. It manages dedicated ARK server installations using SteamCMD/Proton and provides server configuration and management from your browser. This Unraid template uses host networking so game, query, peer, and RCON ports can be managed directly on the Unraid host without maintaining large Docker port mappings.

paths.name: AASM Data
paths.description: Persistent Cerious AASM application data, SteamCMD files, ARK server installations, saves, and server configuration.

paths.name: AASM Config
paths.description: Persistent Cerious AASM application configuration and logs.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns the appdata folders and runs the app. 99 is Unraid's nobody user.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns the appdata folders and runs the app. 100 is Unraid's users group.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Permissions mask for files the app creates. 000 matches Unraid's other appdata containers.

variables.name: Web UI Port
variables.description: Port used by the Cerious AASM web interface. Host networking exposes this port directly on the Unraid host.

variables.name: Authentication Enabled
variables.description: Enable Cerious AASM web authentication. Enter true or false.

variables.name: Username
variables.description: Username used when Cerious AASM web authentication is enabled.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Password used when Cerious AASM web authentication is enabled.

variables.name: Network Mode Indicator
variables.description: Tells Cerious AASM that Docker is using host networking.
